item.title: FDA approves new kind of cholesterol pill
item.description:
📝 Treatment with Lipfendra resulted in an average 56% reduction in LDL-C at Week 24 compared with placebo. In the second trial, which enrolled adults with HeFH, participants had a mean baseline LDL-C of 119 mg/dL. Treatment with Lipfendra resulted in an average 59% reduction in LDL-C at Week 24 compared with placebo.

item.title: I built a browser-based P2P file transfer tool using WebRTC
item.description:
📝 Los dejaremos listos dentro de AirDows Sin cuenta, sin recompresión, ambos dispositivos permanecen activos durante el envío AirDows conecta dos dispositivos durante el tiempo justo para entregar el archivo. AirDows funciona desde el navegador No crea un enlace para descargarlos después. AirDows mueve el archivo seleccionado sin reducir su resolución ni volver a codificarlo Abre AirDows en tus dos dispositivos.
🔗 Read more: https://airdows.com/

item.title: Deepsec
item.description:
📝 deepsec pnpm install # installs deepsec from npm # Proceed as instructed by `init` output Now have your coding agent bootstrap your installation. deepsec/: pnpm deepsec scan pnpm deepsec process pnpm deepsec revalidate # optional, cuts FP rate pnpm deepsec export --format md-dir --out. Security model of deepsec itself Treat deepsec like a coding agent with full shell access on the enviroment that it is running on.
